# GetChannelFalloff

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetChannelFalloff:Int32 channel:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [EmitSound](EmitSound). |

**Returns:** `0` for the curve of this runtime, `1` for the curve of the original and `2` for the curve of SoLoud. A channel that is over gives the default of [GetFalloff](GetFalloff).

## Description

Tells the curve that the volume of a 3D sound falls off by. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print GetChannelFalloff(channel)
```
